title: Moment inequality for the uniform interval
statement: For the uniform distribution on $[-1,1]$, the fourth moment is at most $\frac95$ times the square of the second moment: $\frac12\int_{-1}^{1}x^4\,dx\leq\frac95\left(\frac12\int_{-1}^{1}x^2\,dx\right)^2$.
